pedestrian_crossing_intention_qa.Question: Will the pedestrian located at [417, 809, 556, 1136] in frame 1 cross the road? Justify your answer with spatial, temporal, mathematical, ego-vehicle, and scene-context reasoning. Conclude the pedestrian’s motives.
